People keep asking me, plan and thoughts are unchanged, here’s my rant:

1) I’m still short btc and eth. Not as heavy as I should have been, barely half portfolio hedged.

2) I still hold large positions in the same 4 long term bags I’ve had for two years now plus orbio. 

3) The only thing I’m buying fresh is my own blood on zeroed out onchain bags. They are all so reckt it’s a minuscule protion of my stabkes I’m doing this with. I’m downbad onchain last couple of weeks like everyone else that isn’t larping. Difference is I don’t full port that shit like most insane clowns around here.

I plan to take profits on my shorts at some point in the next 24 hours into PPI tomorrow - wich I think will really matter for a change - and probably look for longs for a relief bounce. Especially on some capitukation wick, if it gives.

But I don’t think we’re done on larger timeframes and it all looks like absolute shit to me, culturally more than anything else. To think that NFT’s has been unrioncially the last thing we produced with any lasting legacy besides hyperliquid, that shit tells you just how bad it has been last couple of years. Like, I barely care about them besides 3 projects, and still, they have more attention and actually long term interested people than almsot anything else. 

A ghost town.

The culture is and always has been what matters here despite what people think. Short term grifts, braindead copytrading, no original thought, grifts and scams, no larger tome horizon, nigilism and straight up crime: what do you expect? 

It will take time and effort to feel, and people around here are allergic to effort and time commitments.

And this is why we’re dying.

Regarding $NVDA

The departure of the founder and CEO is a massive test for any company. Here are the reasons we expect $NVDA to continue to dominate:

💪 huge technological lead in chip design and supply chain control plus CUDA, that all survive a leadership change

💪 Engineering talent is deep. If Jensen was the chief designer of the chips and architecture, the company’s risk would be much greater 

💪 an ownership culture at NVDA: 80% of employees are stock millionaires and 50% own stock worth more than $25 million
These employees are not “punching the clock” and highly motivated to maintain the company’s leadership position 

💪 The stock has an attractive PE multiple and the substantial free cash generation means the company can support the stock via buybacks 

There will be pain near term since many investors view this as an adverse development. It is. But at 10x forward PE, this is also the best risk/reward in AI at the moment
